verdict.rationale: Omnirush is an in-app AI coding agent that works on the user's own projects and reviews pull requests, which gives AI-generated suggestions on the user's code inside the product. Nothing documents insights or analysis over other kinds of user data. Missing for 10: documented insight or suggestion features over user data beyond code (e.g. analytics, summaries), and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`
